> [!TIP]
> **AI-Assisted Issue Resolution**: This project utilizes AI-assisted development tools to triage, diagnose, and expedite the resolution of issues. The more detailed and comprehensive the information you provide (exact version numbers, OS environment, minimal reproduction steps, and full error logs/stack traces), the faster AI tooling and maintainers can diagnose root causes and deliver verified fixes.

**EzSnmpDataLogger release version OR commit SHA**
ex. 2026.11.4a0 OR abcd1234

**Component or Interface**
- [ ] CLI (`ezsnmp-data-logger`)
- [ ] Tkinter Desktop GUI (`ezsnmp-data-logger desktop`)
- [ ] Web Studio GUI / REST Server (`ezsnmp-data-logger web`)
- [ ] C++ Native Core Engine
- [ ] Language Bindings (Python, C#, Go, JavaScript)
- [ ] Telemetry Storage Sink (CSV, JSONL, SQLite, PostgreSQL, Prometheus)
- [ ] Installation / Packaging (Inno Setup, DEB, RPM, DMG, Pip, Docker)

**Operating System and Architecture**
- OS: [e.g. macOS 14/15, Ubuntu 22.04/24.04, Windows 10/11, Docker, RHEL]
- Arch: [e.g. x86_64, ARM64]

**Runtime Versions**
- Python Version (if applicable): `python3 --version` [e.g. 3.11, 3.12, 3.13, 3.14]
- Net-SNMP Version: [e.g. 5.9.x, 5.10.x]
- Compiler / Binding Runtime (if applicable): [e.g. GCC 13, Clang 17, MSVC 2022, .NET 8, Node.js 22, Go 1.22]

**Target Storage Sink & Configuration**
- Sink type: [e.g. SQLite, PostgreSQL, Prometheus, CSV, JSONL]
- Configuration: [redact any sensitive credentials or community strings]

**Describe the bug**
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Run command '...' or open GUI with configuration '...'
2. Perform action '....'
3. See error

**Expected behavior**
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

**Screenshots, Logs, or Stack Traces**
If applicable, add screenshots, console logs, or stack traces to help explain your problem.

**Additional context**
Add any other contextual information about the problem here.

**Do you have a fix already with working code?**
Consider opening a pull request with your fix! Ensure test coverage has been added and all CI actions pass.
